title: I Reported the Stairwell Door Propped With the Serial on the Maglock

parts.text: I found the stairwell door propped with a fire-extinguisher at 6:22 p.m. The maglock serial was on a sticker the facilities lead had posted: DO NOT PROP. REPORT SERIAL. I was thirty, last on the floor, holding a phone. I photographed the serial, the extinguisher used as a doorstop, and the sticker. I reported it as written. Facilities came, fined the team that had gone to the roof for sun. The door closed. The extinguisher went back in its cabinet, which is where extinguishers live when nobody is starring in a safety poster.
